description: Synthetic scam messages for local testing and demos. Not from real victims. Includes a small simulated campaign-evolution sequence (see 'campaign_demo' entries) that mirrors the section-33 example: SMS -> WhatsApp -> Tamil -> Voice, for demonstrating Phase 3's related-incident matching (indicator/domain reuse). Phases 4+ campaign clustering is not implemented yet.

samples.text: Dear Customer, your Bank account will be BLOCKED today due to KYC expiry. Update immediately: http://sbi-kyc-verify.example/update or your account will be suspended.
Congratulations! You have WON Rs. 25,00,000 in the Amazon Anniversary Lottery. Share your bank details and pay a small processing fee of Rs. 500 to claim your prize now.
Your package could not be delivered due to unpaid customs duty of $2.99. Pay now at http://courier-track-pay.example to avoid return to sender within 24 hours.
We reviewed your profile and would like to offer you a Work From Home job paying $500/day. No experience needed. To proceed, install our task app and pay a $50 refundable registration fee.
IRS Notice: You owe $1,289 in unpaid taxes. Failure to respond within 24 hours will result in legal action. Call +1-800-555-0199 immediately to resolve.
Your HDFC Bank account KYC has expired. Verify now to avoid suspension: http://hdfc-kyc-secure.example/verify
